description: This file defines HTTP handlers for a health check endpoint and manages global status variables for a service, including initialization and status updates via a channel.

methods.name: writeJsonResponse
methods.description: Serializes an entity to JSON and writes it to the HTTP response.

methods.name: handleHealth
methods.description: HTTP handler function that responds with the application's health status.

methods.name: listenForStatusChanges
methods.description: Runs as a goroutine to update global status variables based on messages from a channel.

methods.name: StartHTTP
methods.description: Initializes the server, sets up routes, and starts listening for incoming HTTP requests.
